standard-dialogue.npc: Welcome to my humble guild [player name].

options.text: Quite a place you've got here.

steps.player: Quite a place you've got here.

steps.npc: Indeed we do. Would you like to know more about it?

options.text: Tell me about the strength training area.

steps.player: Tell me about the strength training area.

steps.npc: Ahh the mighty warrior Sloane guards the strength training area. This intriguing little area consists of two shotput lanes for different weights of shot. It's fairly simple, the Referee or Sloane can explain more. You
may find yourself panting for breath though.
Well you see my dear [boy/lady], the games there really do sap your energy quite a bit. You can find it just up the stairs behind the bank.

options.text: Tell me about the attack training area.

steps.player: Tell me about the attack training area.

steps.npc: Ahhh, dummies.

steps.player: I'm no dummy, I just want to know what is there!

steps.npc: Oh no my dear [man/lady], I did not mean you at all! The training area has mechanical dummies which pop up out of holes in the floor. The noble dwarf Gamfred invented the mechanism and Ajjat can explain more about what
to do there.

steps.player: Oh, ok, I'll have to try it out!

steps.npc: You can find it just down the corridor and on your right.

options.text: Tell me about the defence training area.

steps.player: Tell me about the defence training area.

steps.npc: To polish your defensive skills to the very highest level we've employed a most inventive dwarf and a catapult.

steps.player: You're going to throw dwarves at me?

steps.npc: Oh my no! I think Gamfred would object to that most strongly.
He's an inventor you see and has built a marvellous contraption that can throw all sorts of things at you including magic missiles...
....spiked iron balls.....
....spinning slashing blades....
... and even anvils.
No need to be afraid, it's all under very controlled conditions! You can find it just up the stairs behind the bank.

options.text: Tell me about the combat training area.

steps.player: Tell me about the combat training area.

steps.npc: Ahh yes, our resident magician from foreign lands created a most amazing gadget which can turn your own armour against you! It's really quite intriguing.

steps.player: That sounds dangerous. What if I'm wearing it at the time?

steps.npc: So far that's not happened. You need to speak to Shanomi about the specifics of the process, but as I understand it, putting a suit of armour in one of these devices will make it come to life some how. The better
the armour, the harder it is to 'kill'.

steps.player: Fighting my own armour, that sounds... weird. I could be killed by it...

steps.npc: Indeed we have had a few fatalities from warriors over stretching themselves and not knowing their limits. Start small and work up is my motto! That and go see Lidio for some food if you need it.

Ahh, yes, our token system is designed to allow you an appropriate amount of time with my discovery in the very top floor of the guild. I won't spoil the surprise as to what that is. Go up and see for yourself. Now, the
amount of tokens you collect from the various activities around the guild will dictate how long Kamfreena will allow you in the enclosure on the very top floor. More tokens equals more time.
If I told you it would spoil the surprise!

steps.player: Ok ok... so how do I earn and claim these tokens?

steps.npc: You can earn them simply by using the training exercises around the guild, the staff will then enter this into a ledger as you play. You can claim them by simply asking any of the staff at the training areas, or
myself.

options.text: Tell me about the strength training area.
Tell me about the attack training area.
Tell me about the defence training area.
Tell me about the combat training area.
You any good with a sword?

steps.player: You any good with a sword?

steps.npc: Am I any good with....a sword... Have you any clue who I am?
Why I could best any person alive in a rapier duel!

My dear [sir/lady], I couldn't possibly duel you, I might hurt you and then what would happen to my reputation! Besides, I have this wonderful guild to run. Why don't you take a look at the various activities we
have. You might even collect enough tokens to be allowed in to kill the strange beasts from the east!
Farewell [brave warrior/fair lady], I do hope you enjoy my guild.

after-completing-while-guthix-sleeps.npc: Welcome to my humble Guild [player name].

steps.npc: I've lost two of my dear friends, [player name]. This old place doesn't seem to be the same since they're gone.
Nonsense, my friend! They both died bravely fighting against a great evil! There is no blame on you for that.
Remember them for who they were and what they stood for. Mourn their loss, but never bear the burden of their death, for that is not what they would want.
Ah, now that is a topic we could debate for many moons, my friend. Still, regardless of the reason, know that when the time comes, I will fight beside you against Lucien once more.

options.text: Could you tell me more about the Guild?

steps.player: Could you tell me more about the Guild?

steps.npc: Of course. What would you like to know about?
